lines.text: About halfway through the feast, Jesus taught in the temple courts, and the Jews were amazed at His learning.
Jesus said Abraham gave them the law, yet not one of them kept it.
Jesus said they circumcise a boy on the Sabbath, yet were angry with Him for making a whole man well on that day.
No one laid a hand on Jesus because His hour had not come, and the Pharisees and chief priests sent officers to arrest Him.
Jesus said they would look for Him but not find Him, and the Jews wondered if He would teach the Romans.
